title: RAF recapture rate
one_line_definition: The share of total known HCC risk weight (Documented and Undocumented) that has been successfully recaptured through documented clinical encounters.
numerator_meaning: Total HCC risk weight for conditions flagged as Documented — meaning conditions that have been coded at a clinical encounter in the current period.
denominator_meaning: Total HCC risk weight for conditions flagged as either Documented or Undocumented — representing all known risk that should be captured, excluding Suspected conditions.
result_meaning: The percentage of known recapturable HCC risk weight that has been successfully documented, indicating how effectively prior-year conditions are being recoded.
scope_note: Only Documented and Undocumented flags are included in this calculation — Suspected conditions are explicitly excluded from both numerator and denominator.

measure_meanings.RAF recapture rate: The proportion of known HCC risk weight (Documented plus Undocumented) that has been recaptured through documented clinical coding in the current period.
measure_meanings.RAF recapture rate YoY Card: Displays the year-over-year percentage change in the RAF recapture rate compared to the same period last year, shown as an upward or downward arrow with the percentage difference.
